definitions.gloss: way home, way back, return path
definitions.explanation: The route taken when returning home or going back to where one came from. Also used to describe the journey itself.

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}った→寄る：02440_yoru⟧。
examples.english: I stopped at a convenience store on the way home.
I got caught in the rain on the way home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧だ。
examples.english: Walking home from school while watching the sunset with friends is a fond memory.

notes:
USAGE:
The opposite is ⟦{行|い}き→行き：02614_iki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ or {行|ゆ}く⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (the way there). Often used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mean "on the way home": {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Can also be used figuratively to mean there is no turning back: {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: on the way home
- {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: on the way back
- {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{急|いそ}ぐ→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧: to hurry on the way home
- {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}う→迷う：02426_mayou⟧: to get lost on the way back
